metadata.title: Clicked like I’m allergic to aiming and somehow gifted 1 poor soul a death?! Valorant logic is wild
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like my mouse is possessed
Enemy: probably questioning their life choices
How did I even get that kill? Still no clue, but I’ll take it
Click if your chaos aim ever surprises even YOU!

Hit like if your aim ever betrayed logic but still got a kill!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
